hero.text: Bonfiire is where students find things to do, host their own events and bring people together, from a park hangout to an Appro across the city.
hero.sceneAlt: Illustration of friends sitting on camping chairs and a log around a bonfire, between two trees with bunting: one sings, one plays the guitar, one roasts a marshmallow and one holds a mug, while two more sit on a log facing the fire.

why.title: Why {Bonfiire}?
text: Student life is full of people, yet it's easy to feel on your own. Plans get lost in group chats, and good events never reach the people who'd love them.

We built Bonfiire to change that, one place to find things to do, bring your own ideas to life and meet the people around you. Like friends around the bonfire, we want people to come closer, and stay close long after the event ends.

ways.title: Ways to bring people {together}
text: Host an event on Bonfiire and bring everyone together, in one place or spread out across the city.

items.mapLabel: A small map with one pin: everything happens in one place.
items.title: Single-location event
items.text: Everything happens in one place. Send the invites, share the details, and welcome everyone in with an e-ticket.

items.mapLabel: A small map with four numbered checkpoints joined by a route.
items.title: Multi-checkpoint event
items.text: The event moves from stop to stop, with a host and a quick QR check-in at every checkpoint, and points or stamps along the way.

popular.title: The most popular {Appro}
text: The city hopper is the Appro most student organisations run. Museums, markets, restaurants, bars and parks, all on one route, with stamps and points along the way.

hostEvent.title: Planning your next {event}?
text: Whether it's a small meetup or an Appro across the city, Bonfiire helps you plan it, invite your people and check everyone in. Our step-by-step guides show you how.

photoBreak.imageAlt: Students laughing during a tug-of-war in the park
photoBreak.quote: Somewhere between the first hello and the last laugh, strangers become friends.

finale.title: Let's start making memories.
text: Student life goes fast. Don't waste it.
